title: Strict positive integer summary
description: Read one JSON object with a values array. Return exactly an object with sum, count and invalid_indices. Include in sum/count only integers strictly greater than zero, preserving duplicates. Zero and negative integers are valid but ignored. Booleans, strings, floats and null are invalid even when numerically integer-like; list their zero-based positions in invalid_indices in input order. Ignore unrelated input fields. Use Python standard library only and write exactly one JSON result to stdout.
